lines.say: You just won the penthouse in your city's lottery. There is one rule.
Never leave the penthouse after nine p.m. Not even for a fire.
Nine oh one. A knock. Someone outside says your name.
You look at the wall of past winners. Every year. Every face smiling.
The winner from nineteen ninety. It's you. Same face. Same shirt.
Would you still move in? Write it in the comments.
